scenario.topic: Choose a venue for a student project celebration with different budgets and travel times
scenario.opening_question: How should we balance budget, travel time, and atmosphere for our project celebration venue?

options.name: Downtown Bistro on Main Street
options.upside: Close to campus with a trendy atmosphere and good food options
options.tradeoff: Higher cost uses most of the budget, leaving little for extras
options.concern: Might be noisy and crowded on weekend evenings
options.best_for: groups prioritizing ambiance and convenience over cost savings

options.name: Riverside Park Picnic Area
options.upside: Very low cost and spacious outdoor setting with scenic views
options.tradeoff: Dependent on weather and requires participants to bring their own food or arrange catering
options.concern: Potential for bugs and limited shelter if it rains
options.best_for: groups wanting to save money and enjoy a relaxed outdoor environment

options.name: University Conference Room 204
options.upside: No cost and very close to campus, easy to set up presentations or awards
options.tradeoff: Lacks festive atmosphere and requires external catering or snacks
options.concern: May feel too formal or dull for a celebration
options.best_for: groups focused on budget and convenience over atmosphere

options.name: Local Family Restaurant on Elm Avenue
options.upside: Comfortable setting with home-style food and private room availability
options.tradeoff: Longer travel time and moderate cost reduces budget for extras
options.concern: Menu options may be limited for dietary restrictions
options.best_for: groups valuing comfort and a private space for conversation

shared_context: The total budget for the venue is capped at $500
The celebration should happen within 1 hour travel time from campus
